connectivity.connectionError: Dropdown menu banner shown when network is up but API requests are failing
connectivity.offline: Dropdown menu banner shown when device is offline (no network path)
about.heading.stale_data: About window section heading for stale data legend
about.line.additional_windows: About window: description of additional usage numbers
about.line.warning_icon: About window status icon legend — refresh warning (triangle icon, distinct from circle degraded icon)
about.line.bold_suffix: About window color coding legend — suffix after bold label
about.line.color_intro: About window color coding intro line
about.line.first_window: About window: description of first/shortest usage number
about.line.orange: About window color coding legend — includes trailing newline
about.line.red: About window color coding legend — includes trailing newline
about.line.stale_prefix: About window stale data legend — describes the bold ! prefix shown in menu bar when data is outdated
about.secondary.additional_explain: About window: explanation of when additional windows appear
about.secondary.outpacing: About window projection explanation (replaces old 'outpacing' explanation)
about.secondary.refresh_explain: About window refresh behavior explanation — describes three-mode adaptive polling
about.window.title: About window title bar
credentials.alert.invalid_org.message: Alert message for invalid organization ID format
credentials.alert.invalid_org.title: Alert title for invalid organization ID
credentials.alert.missing.message: Alert message when credentials are empty
credentials.alert.missing.title: Alert title when credentials are empty
credentials.alert.save_failed.message: Alert message when keychain save fails
credentials.alert.save_failed.title: Alert title when keychain save fails
credentials.configure: Inline error when credentials are not yet set up
credentials.alert.duplicate_org.message: Alert body when the entered Organization ID is already used by another profile.
credentials.alert.duplicate_org.title: Alert title when the entered Organization ID is already used by another profile.
credentials.alert.limit_reached.title: Alert title shown when the user tries to add an account beyond the maximum number of accounts.
credentials.alert.limit_reached.message: Alert message explaining that an existing account must be removed before adding a new one.
credentials.field.name: Label for the profile name text field in the credential form.
credentials.field.name_placeholder: Placeholder example for the profile name field.
error.unexpected_status: Service error: unexpected HTTP status code. %ld is the status code number.
graph.credit.description: Graph stats row / tooltip: describes a mid-window usage credit (Anthropic lowering utilization without resetting the window). %1$ld is the utilization percent before the credit, %2$ld is the percent after. No count/plural involved.
graph.now: Graph 'now' marker label and hover tooltip current-time label
graph.stats.blocked: Graph stats: usage at 100%%, blocked. %1$@ is a localized absolute time when the window resets.
graph.stats.blocked_date: Graph stats: usage at 100%%, blocked, reset on a different day. %1$@ is a localized date+time string (Apple automatically inserts 'at' between date and time, so do NOT add 'at' before %1$@ in translations).
graph.stats.collecting: Graph stats: not enough data for rate calculation. No format args.
graph.stats.idle: Graph stats: zero consumption rate. %1$ld is headroom percent.
graph.stats.limit_soon: Graph stats: rate projects to hit limit. %1$@ is rate, %2$@ is how long before reset the limit will be hit.
graph.stats.limit_soon_timed: Graph stats: rate projects to hit limit, with reset time shown. %1$@ is rate, %2$@ is how long before reset the limit will be hit, %3$@ is localized time (or datetime if not today) when the window resets.
graph.stats.limit_soon_timed_date: Graph stats: rate projects to hit limit, reset on a different day. %1$@ is rate, %2$@ is how long before reset the limit will be hit, %3$@ is localized date+time string (Apple automatically inserts 'at' between date and time, so do NOT add 'at' before %3$@ in translations).
graph.stats.limit_unknown: Graph stats: rate projects to hit limit, no exact time. %1$@ is rate.
graph.stats.projected: Graph stats: rate with projection. %1$@ is rate, %2$ld is projected percent.
graph.stats.limit_at: Graph stats: at the current rate the limit is reached at this clock time today. %1$@ is rate, %2$@ is the localized time the LIMIT is hit (not when the window resets).
graph.stats.limit_at_date: Graph stats: same as graph.stats.limit_at but the limit falls on a later day, so %2$@ is a localized weekday + time (no date, no year). %1$@ is rate. The weekday already carries the "when", so no preposition is needed before %2$@.
guide.org_id_label: Bold label in credential guide step 4
guide.step1.prefix: Credential guide step 1 — text before the link
guide.step2: Credential guide step 2 — wrap terms in **double asterisks** to render them bold
guide.step3.prefix: Credential guide step 3 — text before refresh icon
guide.step3.suffix: Credential guide step 3 — text after refresh icon (includes newline)
guide.step4.hint: Credential guide step 4 — hint text before 'Organization ID' label
guide.step4.prefix: Credential guide step 4 — intro text (includes newline)
guide.step5: Credential guide step 5 — wrap terms in **double asterisks** to render them bold
menu.about: Menu item to open the About window
menu.credentials.configure: Menu placeholder when credentials are not set
menu.interval: Current polling interval label in menu. %@ is the formatted duration (e.g. 30s, 2m, 10m).
menu.loading: Menu placeholder while data is loading
menu.next: Next poll time label in menu. %@ is the formatted time.
menu.quit: Menu item to quit the app
menu.refresh: Menu item to trigger an immediate refresh
menu.resets.prefix: Opening fragment of 'resets in 2h 30m' in usage attributed title
menu.section.incidents: Menu section header for active incidents
menu.section.services: Menu section header for service status
menu.section.usage: Menu section header for usage data
menu.updated: Last refresh time label in menu. %@ is the formatted time.
prefs.reset_sound: Checkbox label for playing a sound when a critical usage limit resets
prefs.retention.label: Preferences window label for the history retention field; carries the unit in parentheses so no plural form is needed next to the numeric stepper
prefs.retention.confirm.title: Alert title shown before a retention decrease deletes archived history
prefs.retention.confirm.years_phrase: Pluralized "N year(s)" phrase substituted into prefs.retention.confirm.message's %1$@. May be a plural object; %1$ld is the new retention in years.
prefs.retention.confirm.windows_phrase: Pluralized "N archived usage window(s)" phrase substituted into prefs.retention.confirm.message's %2$@. May be a plural object; %1$ld is the count of archived windows that would be deleted.
prefs.retention.confirm.message: Alert body template: %1$@ is the localized/pluralized years phrase (prefs.retention.confirm.years_phrase), %2$@ is the localized/pluralized windows phrase (prefs.retention.confirm.windows_phrase)
prefs.retention.confirm.delete_button: Confirmation alert destructive button — proceeds with deleting archived history
prefs.retention.confirm.cancel_button: Confirmation alert button — cancels the retention change, deletes nothing
prefs.window.title: Preferences window title bar
prefs.button.add_account: Button that creates a new account from the Add Account tab.
prefs.button.remove_account: Button that removes the current account in Preferences.
prefs.compact_services: Checkbox in Preferences → General: compact Services (one line / affected only) vs the full component list.
prefs.show_graph: Checkbox in Preferences → General that toggles the usage graph in the dropdown.
prefs.tab.add: Label of the Add Account tab in Preferences.
prefs.tab.general: Label of the General settings tab in Preferences.
setup.button.start: Primary action button in setup window
setup.window.title: Setup window title bar
window.scope.all: Label for all-models scope, shown when same-duration model-specific window exists
menu.history.saveFailing: Dropdown menu status line shown when UsageHistory.save() is currently failing (e.g. disk full, read-only volume). %@ is a short formatted time-of-day (e.g. 14:32) of when it started failing.
menu.history.quarantinedCount: Dropdown menu status line: count of quarantined (corrupt/unreadable) history files preserved on disk rather than lost. Plural object; %1$ld is the count.
account.remove.confirm.cancel: Cancel button in the remove-account alert.
account.remove.confirm.message: Body of the confirm-removal alert; %@ is the account name.
account.remove.confirm.remove: Destructive confirm button in the remove-account alert.
account.remove.confirm.title: Title of the confirm-removal alert.
profiles.migrated_default_name: Default name of the account migrated from the single-account version; shown in the account switcher and Preferences tab.
services.all_operational: Single line shown in the Services section when every component is operational.
